tldr: Saturn in the 6th house routes maturity and responsibility through rhythm and service.
body: With Saturn in the 6th house, structure, limits, discipline, time, responsibility, fear, mastery, and earned authority move through daily work, health, habits, service, maintenance, and labor. This makes how your days are built and whether your routine supports the life you say you want a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to create something durable. Left unconscious, it can become fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, harsh self-judgment, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed.
gift: commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to create something durable expressed through rhythm and service.
challenge: fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, harsh self-judgment, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed concentrated in rhythm and service.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
